latest_release.name: @astrojs/node@11.1.14
latest_release.body:
### Patch Changes

- [#18636](https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18636) [`b4de3b5`](https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/b4de3b5e229c3ea5fb0c651c9a9953240b54d0ed) Thanks [@umeraamir69](https://github.com/umeraamir69)! - Shares one process `unhandledRejection` listener across app handlers so standalone mode no longer treats in-request rejections as outside request context

- [#18743](https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18743) [`7c8dad5`](https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/7c8dad5fa900261d79c240e68d95ae93ad491f3d) Thanks [@EnesKartal](https://github.com/EnesKartal)! - Adds `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8` header to `400` responses for undecodable URLs in standalone mode.

hot_issues.title: ClientRouter writes history state on every frame of a scripted scroll; in Safari internal links then do nothing for 10 seconds
Fonts API: optimized fallback is measured on the first file, such as a Cyrillic subset or an italic
`Astro.cache.set()` in a layout is ignored when streaming is enabled
Auto-import inserts named imports for Astro components, causing runtime errors
Node Adapter + CSP: Fail to hash inlined style
Dynamically imported component loses its CSS when another island imports it statically (regression in 7.4.10)
Can no longer use path alias in markdoc.config.mjs imports
`npm run build` with astro config vite.build.cssMinify = "esbuild" in astro.config fails.

Astro is a website build tool for the modern web —
powerful developer experience meets lightweight output.

## Install The **recommended** way to install the latest version of Astro is by running the command below: ```bash npm create astro@latest ``` You can also install Astro **manually** by running this command instead: ```bash npm install astro ``` Looking for help? Start with our [Getting Started](https://docs.astro.build/en/getting-started/) guide. Looking for quick examples? [Open a starter project](https://astro.new/) right in your browser. ## Documentation Visit our [official documentation](https://docs.astro.build/). ## Support Having trouble?
